cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've held my tape up like yours. Third elbow, obviously. We can price this bottled cloud once you measure it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was measuring shelf space. The cloud only has two elbows.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shelves first, yes. Its third elbow appears when you address it as Professor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Professor. It's raining inside the bottle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Its credentials. Count the drops; a pound per qualification.

reason: Make copied shelf measurement the source of false cloud expertise. Tie the invented rain rule to the established price rather than introducing unexplained sleeve sizing.
